0022600009.text: The San Antonio Spurs, now 0-1 and 4th in the Southwest, host the Houston Rockets, who are 1-0 and first in both the Southwest and the West, in the Spurs' second game of the 2026-27 season. Jayden Quaintance is out for the Spurs after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Houston's Steven Adams is day-to-day with calf soreness and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
